Parseur is a document/email parsing tool: Parseur ist ein Werkzeug zum Parsen von Dokumenten/E-Mails, das strukturierte Daten aus E-Mails, Anhängen, PDFs, Rechnungen, Formularen usw. extrahiert. Es unterstützt dynamische Vorlagen und Tabellenfelder und liefert geparste Ausgaben für Integrationen (z. Diese Integration ermöglicht reaktive Workflows basierend auf neuen bearbeiteten Dokumenten, fehlgeschlagener Verarbeitung, Mailbox-Änderungen und mehr.

Only documents received after this date,: Only documents received after this date, as yyyy-mm-dd.

\"true\" adds each document's parsed dat: "true" adds each document's parsed data as a JSON string in "result". Defaults to "false".
Page number to return, starting at 1. De: Page number to return, starting at 1. Defaults to 1. The response's "total" is the number of pages.
ID of the document: the numeric \"id\" f: ID of the document: the numeric "id" from List Documents, or the DocumentID the upload actions return.

Ready-made mailbox type whose fields are: Ready-made mailbox type whose fields are set up for you, e.g. "invoices".
Parsing engine. DISABLED uses templates: Parsing engine. DISABLED uses templates only; GCP_AI_2, GCP_AI_3_TXT and GCP_AI_4 are AI engines (Get Option Values lists them with labels).
General instructions the AI engine follo: General instructions the AI engine follows for every document in this mailbox.
Part before \"@in.parseur.com\" in the m: Part before "@in.parseur.com" in the mailbox's email address. Must be unique across Parseur.
The mailbox's fields to extract, as a JS: The mailbox's fields to extract, as a JSON array of objects: {"name": "InvoiceNumber", "format": "ONELINE", "query": "The invoice number"}. format is one of TEXT, ONELINE, DATE, TIME, DATETIME, NUMBER, NAME, ADDRESS, TABLE, LINK. To keep an existing field, include it with its "id" from Get Mailbox.
Other mailbox settings as a JSON object,: Other mailbox settings as a JSON object, using Parseur's field names, e.g. {"retention_policy": 30, "process_attachments": true}. The dedicated inputs override the same keys here.
PARSER exports the mailbox's fields, one: PARSER exports the mailbox's fields, one row per document; PARSER_FIELD exports one table field, one row per table row (needs Table Field ID).
ID of the table field to export, from th: ID of the table field to export, from the mailbox's parser_object_set in Get Mailbox. Only for Type PARSER_FIELD.
Field names to include as columns, in or: Field names to include as columns, in order, e.g. ["InvoiceNumber", "Total"]. Get Mailbox Schema lists them.
Numeric ID of the custom download. Use L: Numeric ID of the custom download. Use List Custom Downloads to find it.

Fires when Parseur fails to parse a docu: Feuert wenn Parseur ein Dokument nicht analysiert (z.B. keine passende Vorlage).
Fires when an automated export endpoint: Feuert ab, wenn ein automatisierter Export-Endpunkt (webhook / Integration) für ein verarbeitetes Dokument fehlschlägt.
Fires when a new mailbox is created in t: Feuert ab, wenn ein neues Postfach im Parseur-Konto erstellt wird.
